title: MZ Sound effects for opening, closing, and advancing text boxes?

posts.author: MHDevBlue
posts.body:
I've been told that the only way to do this is by manually placing sound effects before, between and after each text box. However, this would be a really big time sink and I would have to go back and retrofit a ton of messages.
Would it be reasonable to ask if anyone could whip up a plugin that plays SFX upon the text box opening, advancing to the next text box, and then closing?

You don't need a custom plugin for this. VisuStella MZ Message Core has built-in options for open, next, and close sounds. Yanfly's Message Core for MV does the same. If you're not using those, a simple plugin would still be easy to make. Check the plugin request section—someone might have already done it.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Yanfly is for MV though it might work with Fossil. Didn't spot options in VS Message Core of setting SEs like that (edit: but maybe there are ones?).
Anyway, you should clarify if you want 3 different SEs for open, close and "continue" or just same SE for all those cases? If it's same for everything, it's just simple edits of two methods I think. If you want different ones, I guess you'd have to check the interpreter what is the next command so you can differentiate between continue and close.
edit: Or actually maybe you can just check
$gameMessage.hasText()
because that seemed to return true even when it's an empty text box.
